landing.heroTitle: Conquer English, one word at a time
landing.heroSubtitle: Thousands of words mapped to IELTS and CEFR levels: Uzbek and Russian explanations, pronunciation, examples, and spaced repetition.
landing.feature1Body: Every word comes back exactly when you start to forget it. Anki's power — without the complexity.
landing.feature2Body: Words explained in your native language: translations, pronunciation, examples, and the mistakes Uzbek learners actually make.
landing.feature3Body: A clear path from A1 to C2. Need Band 6.5? There's a word list built for your goal.
landing.feature4Body: Streaks, leagues, and achievements — with no punishment for mistakes. A day off won't burn your streak.
landing.pricingFreeDesc: The core learning loop is free forever: words, reviews, games.
landing.pricingPremiumDesc: All games, AI tutor, offline mode, and deep statistics.
landing.pricingNote: Pay with Payme, Click, or Uzum — no Visa card needed.
